title: Panchayat Season 5 trailer out 23 Nov; premieres 3 Dec on Prime Video
headline: Banrakas Runs Phulera Now: Panchayat Season 5 Streams 3 Dec
caption:
Panchayat Season 5's trailer is out. Prime Video India released it on Monday, 23 November, ahead of the season's premiere on Thursday, 3 December, on Prime Video in India and more than 240 countries and territories.

In the trailer, Phulera has a new order. Kranti Devi (Sunita Rajwar) is the Pradhan after beating Manju Devi (Neena Gupta) in Season 4's election, and her husband Banrakas (Durgesh Kumar) calls the shots. Pradhan Ji (Raghubir Yadav) is adjusting to life out of office, and the story of Sachiv Ji (Jitendra Kumar) and Rinki (Sanvikaa) takes a turn.

Season 5 arrives 17 months after Season 4 (24 June 2025). By idly's count, that is the show's second-shortest wait between seasons: about 25 months from Season 1 to 2, 24 from 2 to 3, and 13 from 3 to 4.

TVF produces the series; Deepak Kumar Mishra directs and Chandan Kumar writes.
